<script>
  const swiper = new Swiper(".swiper", {
    effect: "coverflow",
    grabCursor: true,
    centeredSlides: true,
    slidesPerView: 3,
    speed: 2000,
    coverflowEffect: {
        rotate: 50,
        stretch: 0,
        depth: 100,
        modifier: 1,
        slideShadows: true,
    },
    loop: true,
    autoplay: {
        delay: 3000, // 3 segundos entre slides
        disableOnInteraction: false, // Continua mesmo após interação manual
    },
});

  
  
</script>

<style>
.swiper{
  position:absolute;
  transform-style:preserve-3d;
  transform:perspective(500px);
  
}

.swiper .swiper-slide{
    background-position: center;
    background-size: cover;
    width: 300px;
    height: 600px;
    border-radius: 32px;
}
  
  .swiper-3d .swiper-slide-shadow-left {
    background-image: none!important;
}
  
  .swiper-3d .swiper-slide-shadow-right {
  	background-image: none!important;
  }
  
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
  .swiper .swiper-slide {
    width: 200px;
    height: 250px;
    border-radius: 20px;
  }
}
  
  
</style>
